notes: Full Range Glockenspiel (Analog Lab), insert 3, played an octave below the written notes so it sounds as written: icy and pure. Big Crystal Bells before it beat at 1 Hz. The preset's own reverb is turned up so the last note rings out instead of stopping. Presets chosen by audition against gate_stems (tuning, octave, wobble, left/right detune); reviews of the bells v1 and v2 replaced the detuned and humming ones.
